name: North Coast 500
description: The famous loop from Inverness around the far north of Scotland: Applecross, Torridon, Ullapool, Durness and John o' Groats

name: Bealach na Bà
description: Single-track pass to Applecross with hairpins and 20% grades, climbing 626 m from sea level; not for caravans or learners

name: Glen Coe (A82)
description: The A82 across Rannoch Moor and down through Glen Coe to Fort William, the most dramatic main road in Britain

name: Road to the Isles (A830)
description: Fort William past Glenfinnan's viaduct and the white sands of Arisaig and Morar to Mallaig

name: Isle of Skye (A87 and the Trotternish loop)
description: Over the Skye Bridge to Portree and around Trotternish past the Old Man of Storr and the Quiraing

name: Snow Roads Scenic Route
description: Blairgowrie to Grantown-on-Spey over the Cairnwell Pass and the Lecht, Britain's highest public roads

name: Causeway Coastal Route
description: Belfast to Derry around the Antrim coast past the Glens of Antrim, the Dark Hedges and the Giant's Causeway

name: Hardknott and Wrynose Passes
description: The Lake District's steepest roads, with 30% grades and tight hairpins between Eskdale and Little Langdale

name: Honister Pass
description: From Borrowdale over to Buttermere past the slate mine, one of the Lake District's great passes

name: Kirkstone Pass
description: The Lake District's highest pass road, from Windermere to Ullswater past the Kirkstone Pass Inn

name: Buttertubs Pass
description: Yorkshire Dales road from Hawes to Swaledale, nicknamed England's only true mountain road by Jeremy Clarkson

name: Snake Pass
description: The A57 over the Peak District moors between Glossop and the Ladybower Reservoir

name: Cat and Fiddle Road
description: Moorland road from Macclesfield to Buxton, famous with motorcyclists for its sweeping bends

name: Cheddar Gorge
description: Winding road up between the limestone cliffs of England's largest gorge in the Mendip Hills

name: Atlantic Highway
description: Along the north coast of Devon and Cornwall past Exmoor, Porlock Hill and Lynmouth

name: Black Mountain Pass
description: The Top Gear road over the Black Mountain in the Brecon Beacons between Llangadog and Brynamman

name: Llanberis Pass
description: Through Eryri (Snowdonia) beneath Snowdon from Llanberis up to Pen-y-Pass

name: Evo Triangle
description: The A543, A5 and B4501 loop over the Denbigh Moors in North Wales, named by Evo magazine
